answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The basalt of work and the umber of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a horizon to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
